title: Sanctification
definition: Sanctification is the work of God by which believers are set apart for Him and progressively transformed into the likeness of Christ.
summary: Sanctification flows from union with Christ. It involves putting sin to death, walking by the Spirit, growing in holiness, and living in obedience to God.
christFocus: Believers are sanctified by looking to Christ and depending on the Holy Spirit. Holiness is not self-salvation, but the fruit of grace working in the redeemed.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Sanctification is both definitive and progressive.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: It requires active obedience empowered by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The goal is conformity to Christ.
